name: Do I need permits for mobile home trim and door repairs in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for mobile home trim and door repairs in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most standard mobile home trim and door repairs in Daly City, such as replacing a damaged door with a similar one or repairing existing trim, permits are typically not required. However, if the repair involves structural modifications, significant alterations to the mobile home's exterior envelope, or changing the size or location of a door opening, a permit might be necessary. It's always best to consult with us or the Daly City Building Division for specific guidance on your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are generally not needed for standard mobile home trim and door repairs in Daly City. However, structural modifications or significant exterior alterations may require one.
